pr_body:
Consume the HttpEntity after the API response is parsed, releasing network and thread resources back to their respective pools.

Leaving them unconsumed does not appear to be causing issues during tests, but it does log a large amount of hanging threads on test failure, making it harder to spot what may be the issue when a thread is hanging during a transform test.

Close #107055
pr_comments: merge conflict between base and head

issue_context.title: [Transform] Release test resources during test execution
issue_context.body:
### Description

While debugging test failures, there are a number of threads and connections hanging waiting to be released.  This is likely due to the InputStream not being closed.  This could potentially slow down tests when the full suite is run, but more likely it's just causing noise in the logs when there is a failure.

review_comments: Why did you have to drop the `assertAcknowledged`?

It was moved into the `putTransform` method so that everyone calling `putTransform` will also call `assertAcknowledged` (which closes the inputstream), then `putTransform` became a `void` to match the other API calls
